Use `runway/gen4_turbo` with the Comfy Router API. Runway provides the model; Router gives it the shared authentication and request route below.

## Quick start

Create a key at [platform.comfy.org/profile/api-keys](https://platform.comfy.org/profile/api-keys) and export it as `COMFY_API_KEY`. The Python and TypeScript snippets use the Comfy SDKs (`pip install comfy-sdk`, `npm install @comfyorg/sdk`); the cURL snippet is the same call over raw HTTP.

**Model ID:** `runway/gen4_turbo`

**Endpoint:** `POST https://api.comfy.org/v2/models/runway/gen4_turbo`

<CodeGroup>
```python Python
import uuid
from comfy_sdk import Comfy

# Reads COMFY_API_KEY from the environment. Store this UUID before starting a
# generation. Use the same value if you retry it.
idempotency_key = str(uuid.uuid4())
with Comfy() as client:
    result = client.models.run(
        "runway/gen4_turbo",
        {
            "duration": 5,
            "promptImage": "data:image/png;base64,",
            "ratio": "1280:720",
            "seed": 42,
        },
        idempotency_key=idempotency_key,
        timeout=660.0,
    )

print(result)
```

```typescript TypeScript
import { comfy } from "@comfyorg/sdk";

// Reads COMFY_API_KEY from the environment.
// The SDK automatically creates an idempotency key and reuses it for automatic retries.
const { data } = await comfy.models.run("runway/gen4_turbo", {
  duration: 5,
  promptImage: "data:image/png;base64,",
  ratio: "1280:720",
  seed: 42,
}, { timeoutMs: 660_000 });

console.log(data);
```

```bash cURL
ROUTER_REQUEST_KEY=$(uuidgen)
curl --max-time 660 https://api.comfy.org/v2/models/runway/gen4_turbo \
  -H "X-API-Key: $COMFY_API_KEY" \
  -H "Idempotency-Key: $ROUTER_REQUEST_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d "{\"duration\": 5, \"promptImage\": \"data:image/png;base64,\", \"ratio\": \"1280:720\", \"seed\": 42}"
```
</CodeGroup>

## Schema

### Input

<ParamField body="duration" type="integer" required>
  Possible values: `5`, `10`
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="model" type="string">
  Model to use for generation. On the Comfy Router route `POST /v2/models/runway/{model}` this field is supplied from the path and MUST NOT be sent; on the v1 `POST /proxy/runway/image_to_video` route it is required and constrained to the RunwayModelEnum (`gen4_turbo`).
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="promptImage" type="string | object[]" required>
  Image(s) to use for the video generation. Can be a single URI or an array of image objects with positions.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="promptText" type="string">
  Text prompt for the generation
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="ratio" type="string" required>
  Possible values: `1280:720`, `720:1280`, `1104:832`, `832:1104`, `960:960`, `1584:672`, `1280:768`, `768:1280`
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="seed" type="integer" required>
  Random seed for generation

  Range: `0` to `4294967295`

  Format: `int64`
</ParamField>

Generated from the schema Router serves at `GET /v2/models/runway/gen4_turbo/openapi.json`, the same document it validates a call against before the request reaches the provider.

### Output

<ResponseField name="createdAt" type="string (date-time)" required>
  Task creation timestamp

  Format: `date-time`
</ResponseField>

<ResponseField name="id" type="string" required>
  Task ID
</ResponseField>

<ResponseField name="output" type="string[]">
  The finished generation's asset URLs — for `runway/gen4_turbo` and `runway/aleph2` each element is a VIDEO URL. Present once the task terminates successfully; this list IS the result.
</ResponseField>

<ResponseField name="progress" type="number">
  Float value between 0 and 1 representing the progress of the task. Only available if status is RUNNING.

  Range: `0` to `1`

  Format: `float`
</ResponseField>

<ResponseField name="status" type="string" required>
  Possible statuses for a Runway task.

  Possible values: `SUCCEEDED`, `RUNNING`, `FAILED`, `PENDING`, `CANCELLED`, `THROTTLED`
</ResponseField>
